title: T3 Code: Long Threads
subtitle: Loading, caching, and scrolling a conversation that never ends

chapters.title: Opening from a saved copy
chapters.blurb: A saved copy shows first. A short gap is replayed from the event log, and a wide gap is replaced by one fresh window.

chapters.title: Paging history with a cursor
chapters.blurb: The newest ten turns come first. Older pages pack backward under turn, row, and byte budgets, and a cursor marks the next page.

chapters.title: Mounting only the rows you can see
chapters.blurb: Each row starts as a ninety-pixel estimate and is measured as it mounts. Pinned rows and remembered heights keep the list honest.

chapters.title: Following the live end, and letting go
chapters.blurb: Following keeps the newest text in view. Scrolling away saves a place, a sent message anchors near the top, and tools scroll to the end.
